label: FishBase, version 04/2025: species and families tables (rfishbase parquet snapshot)
bibliographic_citation: Froese R, Pauly D (eds) (2025) FishBase. World Wide Web electronic publication. www.fishbase.org, version (04/2025).

counts.description: species table rows matching the listed taxa (per taxon: anguilla-anguilla=1, fundulus=40, melanogrammus-aeglefinus=1, pisces=36090, pleuronectes-platessa=1, salmo-trutta=1, selachii=566)

measurement_technique: Literature-compiled species records: maximum length and weight, length-weight relationship parameters, longevity, growth (von Bertalanffy) parameters, habitat and depth.
role: length-weight relationships, maximum size and growth parameters for the listed fishes (Thompson's plaice and haddock weight-length analysis)
notes: The parquet files are the rfishbase snapshot of the FishBase SQL tables (Boettiger C, Lang DT, Wainwright PC (2012) rfishbase. J Fish Biol 81:2030–2039) hosted at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cboettig/fishbase; FishBase itself publishes the data through www.fishbase.se. FishBase's licence is not machine-readable on its pages and is therefore left null.
